title: torch-spyre-forward-compat case record
description: Machine-readable record of one forward-compatibility empirical case: torch-spyre@<sha> exercised against a specific pytorch build (upstream main / nightly-proxy / declared-supported-version) on a specific substrate, with any resulting incompatibilities classified, patched, and re-verified. One JSON file per case. See SKILL.md §12 for prose framing.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Bump only on breaking changes; add fields non-breakingly.

case_id.description: Human-readable case slug, e.g. '2026-08-21-fresh-pod-upstream-main'. Unique within the skill's cases/ directory.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this record was finalized.

operator.description: Who ran the case (e.g. 'Todd Deshane'). Optional but recommended.

torch_spyre.description: The torch-spyre revision under test. Repo is PRIVATE; citation form elsewhere is torch-spyre@<short-sha>:<path>:<line>.

sha.description: Full 40-char commit SHA of torch-spyre main (or branch) exercised in this case.

short_sha.description: Convenience short SHA for prose citation.

declared_torch_spec.description: The torch version specifier as read from pyproject.toml at this SHA (e.g. 'torch~=2.13.0'). MUST be re-read from the repo at runtime, not hard-coded in scripts.

pyproject_line.description: 1-indexed line number in pyproject.toml where declared_torch_spec was read.

pytorch.description: The PyTorch build the case was exercised against. Repo is PUBLIC; citation form is https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/<sha>/<path>#L<line>.

mode.description: Which forward-compat probe this case represents. EXACT_UPSTREAM_MAIN: pytorch built from a specific main SHA (highest signal). NIGHTLY_PROXY: an official nightly wheel whose SHA we resolved (proxy for main). DECLARED_SUPPORTED_VERSION: the version torch-spyre's pyproject.toml declares (control baseline).

sha.description: Full 40-char pytorch/pytorch commit SHA the wheel or source build corresponds to. For DECLARED_SUPPORTED_VERSION this is the tagged release commit.

version_string.description: Value of torch.__version__ inside the environment (e.g. '2.13.0', '2.14.0.dev20260820+cpu', '2.14.0a0+git7396101').

nightly_date.description: Only meaningful when mode == NIGHTLY_PROXY. The dev date embedded in the wheel version.

install_source.description: How torch was installed (e.g. 'pip install --pre torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cpu', 'built-from-source', 'pip install torch==2.13.0').

substrate.description: Where the case ran. Fresh pods are preferred; note any pre-existing state.

kind.description: fresh_pod = ImageStream-based dev pod created for this case only.

base_image_digest.description: Immutable image digest (sha256:...) captured at pod-creation time. Recording the digest, not just the tag, is required so the case is reproducible after ':latest' moves.

control_result.description: Result of running torch-spyre against its DECLARED_SUPPORTED_VERSION on the same substrate. Establishes that the substrate itself is healthy before we ascribe any forward-run failure to forward-incompat.

status.description: PASS = import + sentinel workloads green on declared-supported torch. FAIL invalidates the case (substrate broken). SKIPPED only when explicitly justified.

sentinels_run.description: Named workloads that formed the control set.

forward_result_before_fix.description: Result of running the same torch-spyre SHA against the forward pytorch (mode = EXACT_UPSTREAM_MAIN or NIGHTLY_PROXY) BEFORE any compatibility patches are applied. This is the raw empirical signal.

status.description: PASS: no incompatibilities found (rare but real; final_status will be NO_INCOMPATIBILITIES). PARTIAL: some sentinels pass, some fail. FAIL: import or all sentinels fail.

failing_stage.description: Earliest stage at which the forward run breaks.

first_traceback_head.description: First ~10 lines of the earliest traceback, verbatim. Long tracebacks belong in the case's raw-logs file, not this field.

failures.description: One entry per distinct incompatibility surfaced (deduped). Empty array iff forward_result_before_fix.status == PASS. Order: earliest-observed first.

failure_id.description: Short slug unique within the case, e.g. 'F1-torch_library-signature'.

classification.description: Which of the 12 taxonomy categories this failure fits. Pick the earliest-applicable category (an ABI change surfacing as a signature mismatch is CPP_ABI_OR_HEADER_CHANGE, not CHANGED_SIGNATURE).

torch_spyre_citation.description: Where torch-spyre touches the incompatibility. Format: 'torch-spyre@<short-sha>:<path>:<line>'.

pytorch_change_pr.description: Optional: PR or issue that introduced the change, e.g. 'pytorch/pytorch#123456'.

traceback_excerpt.description: Verbatim excerpt (may be empty for import-time or static-grep detections).

fix.description: The patch applied. Omit if not yet fixed (in which case final_status must be UNRESOLVED or PARTIAL_FIX).

strategy.description: DUAL_COMPAT_SHIM keeps declared-supported working; REWRITE_AGAINST_NEW_API breaks it (moves supported_version_regression toward true).

patch_ref.description: e.g. branch name, PR URL, or path to the diff artifact under the case's dir.

verifies_declared_supported.description: True iff the fix keeps the DECLARED_SUPPORTED_VERSION control still passing.

verifies_forward.description: True iff the fix makes the forward pytorch run pass this failure.

forward_result_after_fix.description: Rerun of forward pytorch AFTER all fixes are applied. Omit iff final_status == NO_INCOMPATIBILITIES or UNRESOLVED.

final_status.description: Case-level verdict. NO_INCOMPATIBILITIES: forward_result_before_fix.status == PASS. ALL_FIXED_DUAL_COMPAT: every failure has a fix and every fix.verifies_declared_supported == true. ALL_FIXED_LATEST_ONLY: every failure fixed but at least one fix broke the declared-supported version. PARTIAL_FIX: some failures fixed, others not. UNRESOLVED: no forward failures fixed.

supported_version_regression.description: True iff any applied fix breaks the DECLARED_SUPPORTED_VERSION control. Equivalent to (final_status == ALL_FIXED_LATEST_ONLY) OR (any failure.fix.verifies_declared_supported == false). MUST be explicit; do not infer at read time.

artifacts.description: Pointers to raw evidence stored alongside this record (relative paths under the case dir).

notes.description: Free-form operator notes. Keep verbatim command output in artifacts, not here.
